purpose: Locally-archived public-domain / openly-licensed source documents for the Nonfiction Source Pack v1.1. Only documents with explicit open licensing (Public Domain, CC-BY, CC0, Open Access with redistribution rights, IETF Trust) are archived here. Copyrighted material is NOT archived — only metadata + lawful excerpts in ../metadata/.
licensePolicy: All archived documents below are either U.S. federal government works (Public Domain per 17 U.S.C. §105), CC-BY licensed, or IETF Trust contributions (royalty-free per RFC 5378). Each entry records the license and the lawful basis for archival. v1.1 adds explicit ARCHIVED_FULL_DOCUMENT vs ARCHIVED_LANDING_PAGE classification + SHA256 hashes (v1 had prose-only classification).
